Comment: Deploy agent loop with two budgets. phase_invoke counts cycles: progressCount (awaitingHitl=false, 60 s waits, limit 240 = about 4 h of polling) and hitlCount (awaitingHitl=true, 60 s waits, limit 1440 = about 24 h waiting on a human in AWS Transform). History: each cycle is Task (5 events) + Choice (2) + Wait (2) = 9 events; worst case (240 + 1440) cycles x 9 = 15,120 events, plus the terminal path (Pass 2 + MarkFailed 5 + up to 3 retries x 3 events + Fail 1 = 17) and about 5 start/end events, about 15,142 in total, well under the 25,000-event limit. Wall time: 1680 cycles x (60 s + invoke time) is about 42 h at 30 s per invoke, inside the 72 h execution timeout; the terminal retries add at most 4 x 120 s Lambda timeouts + 14 s of backoff. Attestation runs inside phase_invoke when the agent returns ok; MarkDelivered/MarkFailed update DynamoDB and delete deploy-target keys (phase_deploy_status is idempotent, so a retry after a partial success only re-checks the keys). Executions that end without reaching MarkFailed (timeout, abort, a terminal task failing after its retries) are cleaned up by the EventBridge rule DeployExecutionEndedRule (infra/platform/platform.yaml).

error.Cause.$: States.Format('Progress-poll budget exhausted: {} polls (60 s apart, limit 240) without the deploy finishing. Last reason: {}', $.progressCount, $.lastReason)

States.Format('Human-input wait budget exhausted: {} waits (60 s apart, limit 1440, about 24 h) for an answer in AWS Transform. Last reason: {}. Pending input: {}', $.hitlCount, $.lastReason, $.pendingSummary)
